title: SG Light
html:
SG_Light is a status group.

List of conditions in SG_Light

Condition Effects
Branding Smite
  • Cannot turn Invisible.
Burning
  • Takes 1d4⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
  • Can be removed with the  Help action, using a Healing Potion or gaining Wet.
  • Immune from if Wet.
  •  Dip action can be used on Burning characters or objects.
Burning
  • Takes 1d4⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
  • CANNOT be removed with the  Help action, using a Healing Type Potion or gaining  Wet.
Burning Fiercely
  • Takes 1d10⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
Continual Flame
  • Enveloped in flames that produce no heat and never seem to die out.
  • Identical to the  Light condition.
Daylight
  • Shining with the light of the sun. Dispels  Darkness within a radius of 15 m (50 ft).
  • The Enchant Item version of this spell requires the target creature have a Weapon in their main hand.
Faerie Fire
  • Shedding dim light. Incoming attacks have  Advantage. Cannot be Invisible.
Guiding Bolt
  • The next  Attack Roll made against this creature has  Advantage.
Holy Fire
  • Takes 1~4⁠⁠Radiant damage per turn.
Infernal Burning
  • Takes 1d4⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
  • CANNOT be removed with the  Help action, using a Healing Type Potion or gaining  Wet.
  • The entity affected cannot regain Hit Points
Lathander's Light
  • Sheds holy light in a 6 m (20 ft) radius. In combat, fiends and undead standing in the light are  Blinded, unless they succeed a  Constitution Saving Throw.
Light
  • This object has an aura of light with a radius of 7.5 m (25 ft).
Melting
  • Takes 10d6⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
Produce Flame
  • A flickering flame sheds light in a 9 m (30 ft) radius around the creature.
Roiling Hellfire
  • Flames from the heart of Avernus engulf this entity, inflicting 6d6⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
Sacred Flame
  • The affected entity sheds light in 1.5m radius. It cannot become  Invisible. Enemies are more likely to target this character during the trial.
Scorching Aura
  • Attacks dealt by this entity deal a bonus 1d6⁠⁠Fire unless it is made  Wet.
Searing Smite
  • Takes 1d6⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
  • The condition ends if target succeeds a Constitution  Saving Throw.
Starry Form: Archer
  • In Starry Form. As a Bonus Action, you can cast  Luminous Arrow.
Starry Form: Chalice
  • In Starry Form. Whenever you cast a healing spell that consumes a spell slot, you can cast  Chalice Healing.
